gloss: shortness of breath; being out of breath

definitions.gloss: shortness of breath, being out of breath
definitions.explanation: Difficulty breathing or catching one's breath, often occurring during physical exertion or as a symptom of illness.

examples.japanese: {階段|かいだん}を{上|のぼ}ると{息切|いきぎ}れがする。
examples.english: I get out of breath when I climb stairs.

examples.japanese: {息切|いきぎ}れがひどくなったら{休憩|きゅうけい}しよう。
examples.english: Let's take a break if the shortness of breath gets worse.

examples.japanese: {動悸|どうき}と{息切|いきぎ}れが{主|おも}な{症状|しょうじょう}だ。
examples.english: Palpitations and shortness of breath are the main symptoms.

examples.japanese: {少|すこ}し{歩|ある}いただけで{息切|いきぎ}れする。
examples.english: I get out of breath from just walking a little.

notes:
MEDICAL/HEALTH TERM:
{息切|いきぎ}れ describes difficulty breathing or feeling out of breath, and can be a normal response to exertion or a symptom of medical conditions.

NORMAL CAUSES:
- {運動|うんどう}: Physical exercise
- {階段|かいだん}を{上|のぼ}る: Climbing stairs
- {高地|こうち}: High altitude
- {運動不足|うんどうぶそく}: Lack of exercise

MEDICAL CAUSES:
- {貧血|ひんけつ}: Anemia
- {心臓病|しんぞうびょう}: Heart disease
- {肺|はい}の{病気|びょうき}: Lung disease
- {喘息|ぜんそく}: Asthma

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {息切|いきぎ}れがする: to be out of breath
- {息切|いきぎ}れがひどい: to have severe shortness of breath
- {息切|いきぎ}れを{起|お}こす: to develop shortness of breath

WHEN TO SEE A DOCTOR:
If {息切|いきぎ}れ occurs at rest or with minimal activity, or is accompanied by {胸痛|きょうつう} (chest pain) or {動悸|どうき} (palpitations), seek medical attention.
